column1: # the repeat control of the early rule, which it did not have. PHerc1447-seed44 was grown TWICE with the same binary and the same compiled seed: once from 06:00:07Z under a 10800 s cap and once from 15:10:40Z with no cap, into a folder the first tree had been moved out of. The binary saw 108624 MB free the first time and 89526 the second, and the machine was carrying different work, so the two logs differ in length, 4010300 lines against 3348977, and in where the buffer flush falls. share_of_first_100000 is the rule of DECLARATION.md applied to each. The two differ by 0.00005, against a gap of about 0.07 between the two kinds, so the rule is read from a part of the log the machine state does not move. The MemFree lines the binary prints inline are counted and the share is given with them removed as well: both readings agree.
